leadText:
----
 

Christmas Eve (Japanese: クリスマスイヴ Kurisumasu Ivu) is one of the ending songs of the Japanese Pikachu shorts.

It debuted in Winter Games.

! English

忘れられない夜が　ひとつふえたね
にぎやかだった　やさしくなれた
夢のような　クリスマスイブ
なまえ知らない　星がきらりウインク
会えてよかった　素直になれた
夢のような　クリスマスイブ

ふわりふわり　白い雪
ふわりふわり　まいおりる

つもる雪は　まっ白なラッピング
やさしい時を永遠に　包んでくれたらいいな

きっと　そうなんだよね
みんな　誰かのサンタクロース

クリスマスキャンドル　つくりだす
あたたかな　影もよう

いつか開いた　絵本と同じ
夢のような　クリスマスイブ

ふわりふわり　ふりつづく

つもる雪は　静けさのプレゼント
みんなの笑顔　もういちど夢であえたらいいな

くもったガラス窓に
誰かが描いた　サンタクロース

クリスマスキャンドル　消えた後も
やさしさは　輝いて
やさしさは　輝いて 

Nigiyaka datta yasashiku nareta
Yume no yō na kurisumasu ivu
Namae shiranai hoshi ga kirari uinku
Aete yokatta sunao ni nareta
Yume no yō na kurisumasu ivu

Fuwari fuwari shiroi yuki
Fuwari fuwari maioriru

Tsumoru yuki wa masshiro na rappingu
Yasashii toki o eien ni ysutsunde kuretara ii na

Kitto sō nandayo ne
Minna dareka no Santa Kurōsu

Kurisumasu kyandoru tsukuridasu
Atataka na kage moyō

Dokoka tōku de beru ga hitotsu natta ne
Itsuka hiraita ehon to onaji
Yume no yō na kurisumasu ivu

Fuwari fuwari shiroi yuki
Fuwari fuwari oritsuzuku

Tsumoru yuki wa shizukesa no purezento
Minna no egao mō ichido yume de aetara ii na

Kumotta garasu mado ni
Dareka ga kaita Santa Kurōsu

Kurisumasu kyandoru kieta ato mo
Yasashisa wa kagayaite
Yasashisa wa kagayaite 

It was busy but yet kind
A dreamlike Christmas Eve
A star whose name I don't know winks with a flash
I'm so glad I could meet you, I've become honest
A dreamlike Christmas Eve

Gently, gently, the white snow
Gently, gently, flutters down

The accumulating snow is a pure white wrapping
I hope this tender moment could envelop us eternally

I think, yes, I'm sure
Everyone is Santa Claus to someone

The Christmas candles give off
A warm shadow pattern

Somewhere far away a bell rang once
Just the same as a picture book I once opened
A dreamlike Christmas Eve

Gently, gently, the white snow
Gently, gently, continues to fall

The accumulating snow is a present of serenity
I hope that once again, I can meet everyone's smiles in my dreams

On the frosted glass window
Someone drew a Santa Claus

Even after the Christmas candles are extinguished
The kindness shines on
The kindness shines on
